RESULTS — 1,000 eval queries, 10,000 products, model version 12
Recall@20 overall 0.845 · NDCG@20 0.560 · MRR 0.412 — and the per-slice view is where the story is
Bags and hats score HIGHEST — the category filter means they compete against far fewer distractors.
Recall@20 by size of garment in frame
Small items fail almost completely — and 976 of 1,000 queries are 'large'.
976 of 1,000 eval queries are 'large'. A real user
photographs a whole outfit — the jacket fills 15%
of the frame, a bag maybe 3%. Those are the
medium and small buckets, at 0.385 and 0.091.
So 0.845 is measured on a distribution that does
not resemble production. The per-slice table
revealed it; an aggregate number never would.

Architecture mapped onto Kreuzberger, Kühl & Hirschl, "MLOps: Overview, Definition, and Architecture" (IEEE Access, 2023). Models: yainage90/fashion-object-detection · yainage90/fashion-image-feature-extractor.
